component: ZenDB v2.0.1 M1 synthetic authoritative-data proof
status: EXECUTED 2026-08-02: the corrected runner passed on a fresh ephemeral project-local DFX loopback replica. This is limited synthetic local evidence for the logical-ID recovery protocol; it does not make ZenDB or any collection authoritative.

runner.network: fresh project-local ephemeral loopback DFX local network
runner.networkBoundary: The corrected runner configures local as 127.0.0.1:0, pings it before creation, uses --network local for every DFX operation, creates with --no-wallet, and forces DFX's built-in anonymous identity so no developer PEM/keyring, wallet, or signing authority is selected. Every DFX operation is bounded to 180 seconds with a 10-second kill grace and a cleanup trap. It does not invoke mops install because Mops 2.19.2 makes an unrelated compatibility request before resolving the pinned lock.
